admin_intro:
This module gives you a **dock**: a small panel that shows, among your partners, **the ones that are live right now**. You see at a glance who to raid. One click on a channel copies the raid command: you just paste it in your chat. Nothing is ever sent for you.

**Your raid list lives in Contacts**: it is the cards of the “{label}” category (or the one chosen in the “Raid list” setting) that have a Twitch channel. Add and remove channels here, with the fields above: the cards stay in Contacts. You run a **community**? Put all its members there (even several thousands) and give the dock address to each of them: they have nothing to install, they just add it in OBS.
addr_steps:
1. Copy the address below.
2. In OBS, open the **Docks** menu, then **Custom Browser Docks**.
3. Type a name (for example “Raid”), paste the address, then click **Apply**.

The dock appears: put it wherever you like. You can also open the address in a tab of your browser.

**This address opens your dock to anyone who has it.** For your own use, keep it to yourself. For a community, give it to your members, and know that you can replace it at any time with “New address”: the old one then stops working for everyone. The dock never shows your notes or this address: only what Twitch already shows to everyone (name, game, title, viewers).
check_none: Everything works: nobody is live right now. Channels in your list: {n}.
renew_help: If the address was shared by mistake, or if someone should no longer have access, create a new one. The old address stops working right away for everyone, your members included: each of them will have to add the new one in OBS.
renew_confirm: Create a new address? The old one will stop working FOR EVERYONE: the dock of each person who has it will show an error until they paste the new address.
renewed: Done. The old address no longer works for anyone. Copy the new address above and give it to whoever needs it.
dock_copy_failed: Could not copy here. Select the command below and copy it (Ctrl+C).
dock_none_to_pick: Nobody to pick: none of your partners is live right now.
dock_empty: None of your partners is live right now.
dock_empty_hint: This page updates by itself. Channels in your list: {n}.
dock_no_partners: Your raid list is empty. On the “Twitch raid” page of your site's administration, add your first channel with the “Add a channel” field.
dock_nr_no_channel: First set up your channel in My Twitch channel: no Twitch channel is set up on your site yet.
dock_nr_channel_unknown: The channel chosen for Twitch raid is no longer one of your Twitch channels. Choose another one in the settings of Twitch raid.
dock_nr_setup: First set up the Twitch connector: the ID or the secret of your Twitch application is missing.
dock_nr_refused: Twitch refuses your site's application. In the Twitch connector, check the ID and the secret of the application.
dock_nr_outdated: The Twitch connector is too old for this module. Update it in your site's extensions.
dock_err_twitch: Twitch is not answering right now.
dock_err_rate: Twitch asks to wait a little.
dock_retry: Trying again automatically in a few seconds.
dock_denied: This address is not (or no longer) valid. Copy the dock address from the “Twitch raid” page of your site's administration.
mode_full: You have {n} channels: the dock shows all your members who are live. Above {max} channels, it offers a “Find a streamer online at random” button instead.
mode_random: You have {n} channels: the dock offers a “random” button rather than the full list. Up to {max} channels it shows every member who is live. Why? Twitch only lets us check 100 channels at a time: on a very large community, showing everyone would need far too many requests.
check_random_found: Everything works. Random test: {name} is live.
check_random_none: Everything works, but nobody was found online during this random test ({n} channels in your list). Try again in a moment.
check_partial: Careful: some channels could not be checked this time (not checked: {n}).
dock_rm_button: Find a streamer online at random
dock_rm_intro: There are many of you! Click the button to find a streamer online to raid: the command is copied for you.
dock_rm_none: Nobody was found online right now, try again.
dock_limited: Too many searches, please wait a few seconds.
dock_partial: Some channels could not be checked.
mode_full_one: You have 1 channel: the dock shows all your members who are live. Above {max} channels, it offers a “Find a streamer online at random” button instead.
list_count: **{n}** Twitch channels in the “{label}” category of Contacts.
list_count_one: **1** Twitch channel in the “{label}” category of Contacts.
list_count_awaiting: **{n}** Twitch channels: your channels from version 1, already in Contacts, waiting for their category.
list_count_awaiting_one: **1** Twitch channel: your channel from version 1, already in Contacts, waiting for its category.
list_empty: No Twitch channel in the “{label}” category yet. Add your first channel with the “Add a channel” field.
list_only: Raid reads the “{label}” category, the only one in your Contacts. For a separate list, create the “{default}” category in Contacts: Raid will pick it up by itself.
list_moved: The chosen category was merged into “{label}”: Raid now reads that one.
list_truncated: Your list has more than {max} channels: only the first {max} are read.
contacts_stale: Contacts does not answer: the dock uses the list read at {time} (10 minutes at most). Nothing is lost.
suggest_reason: keeps your address book, where your raid list comes from
dock_nr_contacts_missing: Twitch raid reads its list in Contacts, which is not installed. Open the “Twitch raid” page of your site's administration: it offers to install it.
dock_nr_contacts_old: Contacts is not recent enough for Twitch raid. Update Contacts in the extensions of your site.
dock_nr_contacts_down: Contacts does not answer right now: the raid list cannot be read.
dock_nr_category_gone: The chosen category no longer exists, choose one in the “Raid list” setting of Twitch raid.
dock_nr_no_category: Your raid list does not exist yet. On the “Twitch raid” page of your site's administration, add your first channel: the “{label}” list is created by itself.
dock_nr_choose: Several categories exist in Contacts. On the “Twitch raid” page of your site's administration, add your first channel: the “{label}” list is created by itself (or pick one in the “Raid list” setting).
mig_copy_todo: Your channels from version 1 are moving to Contacts: {done} of {total} copied. Click “Continue the copy” to finish. Nothing is lost: your version 1 list is kept as it was.
mig_copy_done: Done: your {total} channels are in Contacts.
mig_copy_partial: Copied: {done} of {total}. Click “Continue the copy” again for the rest.
mig_full: Contacts is full (100,000 cards): the copy stopped. Make room in Contacts then click “Continue the copy”.
mig_finish_title: Last step: put your channels in their category
mig_finish_text: {n} cards copied from your version 1 list are not in the “{label}” category yet. The button adds them to it in Contacts (the category is created by itself if it is missing): nothing is deleted, nothing is overwritten. Meanwhile, the dock already uses them.
mig_finish_btn: Put my channels in this category
mig_finish_done: Done: all your channels are in the “{label}” category.
mig_finish_partial: Partly done: {n} left. Click again to continue.
mig_skipped: {n} lines of your version 1 list were not valid Twitch names and were not copied: {list}.
add_blocked: Quick add needs Contacts (see the message at the top of the page). Once Contacts is ready, the “Add a channel” field appears here.
add_help: Type a person's **name** to look for them in your contacts, or their **Twitch name** (or the link to their channel) to add it right away. Their name and picture are taken from Twitch by themselves.
add_will_create: The “{label}” list will be created by itself in Contacts at your first add. You have nothing to do.
add_field_help: For example: Camille, camille_tv, @camille_tv or twitch.tv/camille_tv
add_err_empty: Type a name, a Twitch name or a link.
add_err_empty_handle: Type this person's Twitch name, for example camille_tv.
add_err_chars: “{input}” is not a Twitch name: it can only have letters without accents, digits and _ (for example camille_tv).
add_err_short: “{input}” is too short: a Twitch name has at least 4 characters.
add_err_long: “{input}” is too long: a Twitch name has at most 25 characters.
add_err_not_channel: “{input}” is not a Twitch channel (it is another page of the site). Paste the channel's address, for example twitch.tv/camille_tv.
add_err_unknown_twitch: Twitch does not know “{login}”. Check the spelling of the name.
add_err_category: The “{label}” category could not be created by itself in Contacts (you need the “create categories” right in Contacts). Create it yourself in Contacts, “Categories” page, then try again.
add_err_taken: This Twitch name is already on the card of {name}. Search that person by name to add them to your list.
add_err_person_gone: This person no longer exists in Contacts. Search again.
add_err_too_many_accounts: This card already has many accounts. Remove one in Contacts, then try again.
add_err_invalid: This add could not be understood. Start again from the “Add a channel” field.
add_err_full: Contacts is full (100,000 cards). Make room in Contacts, then try again.
add_done_new: Done: {name} is added to your raid list.
add_done_joined: Done: {name} was already in Contacts, they join your raid list.
add_done_already: {name} is already in your raid list. Nothing changed.
add_n_joined: Already in Contacts, added to the list: {n}.
add_cat_created: The “{label}” list was created in Contacts.
add_twitch_rate: Twitch asks to wait a little: names and pictures will be taken the next time the card is opened in Contacts.
add_twitch_later: The name and picture could not be taken from Twitch for now: the card carries the Twitch name, Contacts will complete it the first time it is opened.
res_no_twitch_intro: These people are in your contacts but **have no Twitch channel**: add their Twitch name, it will be added to their card (no duplicate).
create_handle_help: The only field to fill in: for example camille_tv or twitch.tv/camille_tv
attach_btn: Add to their card and to my list
batch_help: Paste one channel per line (a Twitch name or a link), {max} at most at a time. You will see a preview before anything is added.
batch_field_help: Names or links, one per line. Capitals, @ and spaces are fine.
batch_reason_chars: letters without accents, digits and _ only
batch_invalid_skipped: Invalid lines are skipped. The others are ready.
batch_partial: This takes a while: part is done, {n} left. Click “Continue” (nothing is lost, nothing is doubled).
batch_done: Done. New cards: {added}. Already in Contacts and added to the list: {joined}. Already in the list: {already}.
batch_done_unknown: Names Twitch does not know (not added): {n}.
batch_err_none: There is nothing left to add: the preview expired. Paste your channels again.
batch_err_empty: Paste at least one channel: a Twitch name or link per line.
batch_err_over: You pasted {n} lines: {max} at most at a time. Paste them in several times.
batch_err_none_valid: None of these lines is a Twitch name. A name has 4 to 25 characters: letters without accents, digits and _ (for example camille_tv).
mylist_empty: Your list is empty for now. Add your first channel with the “Add a channel” field.
mylist_no_match: No channel in your list matches “{q}”.
mylist_remove_confirm: Remove from the “{label}” list? The card stays in Contacts.
mylist_removed: Removed from the “{label}” list. Their card stays in Contacts.
mylist_already_gone: They were no longer in the list. Nothing changed.
mo_intro: The **featured picks** choose a few of your partners **who are live** at random: a nudge to raid them, or to discover them. They do not change on every refresh: everybody sees the same members for {minutes} minutes, then a new selection is drawn. The same people do not come back while others are live. It shows up to {count} member(s); if fewer are live, you see those who are. The settings are right below.
mo_addr_steps:
1. Copy the address below.
2. In OBS, open the **Docks** menu, then **Custom Browser Docks**.
3. Type a name (for example “Picks”), paste the address, then click **Apply**.

The **Draw again** button changes the selection for everyone (site visitors included). Clicking a member copies their raid command. This address is secret, like the ordinary dock's: “New address” (tab “My list”) replaces both.
mo_ordinary_shows: The ordinary dock (the one in the “My list” tab) shows the featured picks instead of the list, as you chose below.
mo_page_off: The public page is **off**: only you and your members (through the docks) see the picks. To show them to your visitors, tick “Show the public page on the site” below, then save.
mo_page_on: The public page is **on**. It shows the same members as the dock, each with a “{button}” button, and refreshes itself about every minute. If Twitch does not answer, it keeps the last known selection.
mo_page_nopath: The public page is ticked but has no address on the site yet. Switch to advanced mode: the “Page address” field at the top of this page lets you choose one (for example “live-now”). Then add it to the site menu if you wish.
mo_check_ok: Current picks: {names}. {pool} member(s) can be drawn right now. They renew around {time}.
mo_check_none: Nobody who can be shown is live right now. The picks will appear as soon as one of them is.
mo_check_stale: (Last known picks: Twitch or Contacts is not answering.)
mo_reroll_wait: Wait a few seconds before drawing again.
mo_warn_count: The number of members must be 1 to 10: {count} is used.
mo_warn_duration: The duration must be 1 to 240 minutes: {minutes} minutes are used.
mo_warn_exclude: These words do not look like a Twitch name and are ignored in “Never draw these names”: {list}. Example: camille_tv
mo_warn_exclude_over: The “Never draw these names” list is limited to {max} names: the following ones are ignored.
mo_hide_info: People filed in the Contacts category “{label}” are never drawn or shown.
mo_hide_none: There is no “Do not show” category in Contacts: nobody is left out for that reason. If someone asks not to appear, create that category in Contacts and file their card in it (or choose it in advanced mode).
mo_hide_gone: The “Do not show” category you had chosen no longer exists: nobody is left out by it. Choose another one (advanced mode).
mo_hide_unverified: Contacts is not answering: the “Do not show” category cannot be checked, the picks keep their last version.
fd_wait: Wait a few seconds before drawing again.
fd_empty: None of your partners is live right now.
fd_empty_hint: The picks will appear as soon as one of them goes live. This page updates by itself.
fd_stale: Twitch or Contacts is not answering: last known picks, from {time}.
pub_intro: A few community members are live right now. Come and say hello!
pub_empty_hint: Come back in a moment: this page updates by itself.
pub_unavailable: Live information is not available right now.
pub_unavailable_hint: Try again in a moment: this page retries by itself.
pub_stale: Twitch is slow to answer: here is the last known selection, from {time}.
pub_update_failed: The update did not go through. What is shown dates from {time}.
pub_thumbs_note: Previews are images served by Twitch: they load only if you click.
pub_description: The community members who are live on Twitch right now.
